IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for inference cluster us-west-2. Error spike started ~23:42Z. Top errors: segfaults in model-runner, OOM kills, and gateway 502s. Pager triggered. https://internal.pager/redwood/INC-2026-03-14-4721
Priya (oncall): I'm taking the page. paging Alex and Kofi. putting a short bridge in #incidents-call for anyone joining.
Alex (eng-runtime): pinged. I'll grab logs and core dumps. first immediate thing: isolate the failing variant and scale it to 0 if possible.
Jules (support): customer impact: several paid customers in us-west seeing 10-30% request failures, some 502 spikes at ~23:43Z. Support is sending a proactive note.
Kofi (sre): I'm spinning up two extra infer nodes in the pool and will shift traffic from the overloaded nodes. Also recommend disabling aggressive batching for the impacted model for now.
Priya (oncall): Agreed. Priority mitigations: 1) route 20% traffic to fallback model 2) disable batching on the failing variant 3) take the crashed pods out of the LB.
Alex (eng-runtime): collecting kernel/OOM logs now. commands I'm running:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model-runner -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs <pod> --previous --tail=200
journalctl -u kubelet --since "1 hour ago" | grep -i -E "oom|kill|segfault"
gdb -batch -ex "thread apply all bt" -ex quit /usr/local/bin/model-runner /var/crash/core.<pid>
```
Alex (eng-runtime): quick grep shows repeated segfaults inside attention_kernels.so and a pattern of SIGSEGV in the same offset. stack sample: 
```
#0 0x7f9d2b7a1a3c in softmax_attn_forward at attention_kernels.c:412
#1 0x7f9d2b8f2b60 in run_attention at model_runner.c:1289
#2 0x7f9d2b9c3f10 in infer_step at inference_loop.c:722
#3 0x7f9d2baf0d44 in start_worker at worker_pool.c:101
```
Alex (eng-runtime): also seeing cgroup OOMs on two pods prior to segfaults - possible memory corruption leading to runaway allocation. cores saved to /var/crash, uploading to s3://redwood-debug/1829999999/cores/
Kofi (sre): while Alex digs in, I'm going to temporarily set route policy to fallback: `traffic-split --from model/xlarge-13b --to model/xsmall-3b --percent 20` and disable continuous batching with `BATCHER_MAX_BATCH=1`. Doing a rolling drain of the two nodes with the highest error rates.
OpsBot: Deploy snapshot triggered: canary of runtime-config v2026-03-14-ops1 to 2 pods. Env overrides: KVCACHE_DISABLE=true, MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2, BATCHER_MAX_BATCH=1
Priya (oncall): Good. Also enable ABORT_ON_CORRUPTION=1 in canary so we fail fast and reduce data corruption risk.
Alex (eng-runtime): repro locally with a stress script and model variant; reproduced segfault in ~3000 requests when sequence length > 2048 and kvcache was enabled. Suspect a race in kv cache eviction + quantized attention kernel path.
Jules (support): drafting customer message now. ETA for next update 30m. Doing targeted outreach to 5 highest-usage customers.
Kofi (sre): after routing to fallback and canary rollout, errors dropped from 18% -> 3% over the last 8 minutes. Latency also dropped back to normal.
Alex (eng-runtime): core analysis: memory write beyond buffer in kv_eviction.c line ~278 with corrupt metadata observed. attaching minimal reproducer to internal gist: https://internal.gists/redwood/abcd1234 (private).
Priya (oncall): Mitigation checklist executed: 1) traffic split to fallback 2) disable batching 3) canary runtime with KVCACHE_DISABLE succeeded 4) drained bad nodes 
Kofi (sre): I'm leaving two nodes in canary with the safe runtime. Will keep autoscaler at +2 until morning.
OpsBot: Canary passed health checks: 2/2. Promoting runtime-config v2026-03-14-ops1 to 25% traffic.
Alex (eng-runtime): pushing hotfix patch to attention_kernels: bounds check + assert for kv metadata. Creating PR now, will attach CI artifacts. Short-term: prefer KVCACHE_DISABLE on affected model variants; long-term: kernel fix + extra fuzz tests.
Jules (support): sent interim customer update: explanation, mitigation steps, and ETA for RCA. Customers asked for duration and % of requests impacted; gave conservative numbers (peak 30% during the spike).
Priya (oncall): Logging timeline + actions in the incident doc. Handing off to Sam (night oncall) in 40m. Sam please monitor the canary traffic split and error rate, and keep Kofi and Alex on the notify list.
Sam (night-oncall): taking handoff. I have access to the docs and the s3 debug bundle. I'll keep watch and wake eng if error rate climbs above 5%.
Alex (eng-runtime): note for postmortem: we need an automated tracer that correlates segfaults to model config (kv cache + quant path) and adds a guard to the router to prevent routing new variants until self-check passes.
Kofi (sre): follow-ups: 1) emergency test in staging for long sequences and kv eviction 2) increase canary duration next rollout 3) add metric for per-variant segfaults to alert earlier.
Priya (oncall): status: service degraded -> partial recovery. Next update/closure pending PR & verification in staging and a customer-facing RCA. Thanks everyone for quick actions. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: INCIDENT STATUS: partial mitigation in place. Assigned owners: eng-runtime (Alex) for fix, sre (Kofi) for canary/rollout, support (Jules) for customer comms. Incident channel locked for updates.
